description:
**Phase A — Foundation. Deps: none.**

NO settings reader exists today (verified: resource_loader.ex / provider_config.ex / runtime_state.ex have nothing). Full port of `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:146-153, 258, 105-133` required.

This is the **first consumer** of a project-wide settings system; design accordingly (other features will follow).

- Discovery: `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` (global) and `<cwd>/.pi/settings.json` (project).
- Merge: `deepMergeSettings` — project precedence over global.
- Schema for compaction: `compaction.enabled` (default `true`), `compaction.reserve_tokens` (default `16384`), `compaction.keep_recent_tokens` (default `20000`).

Tests: discovery + merge precedence + missing-file fallbacks.
title: A4. Settings file plumbing (SettingsManager port) + compaction schema
